maddeler.e:
أمتزج (form VIII)
# أَمْتَزِجُ (ʔamtaziju) /ʔam.ta.zi.d͡ʒu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# أُمْتَزَجُ (ʔumtazaju) /ʔum.ta.za.d͡ʒu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# أَمْتَزِجَ (ʔamtazija) /ʔam.ta.zi.d͡ʒa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِمْتَزَجَ (imtazaja)
# أُمْتَزَجَ (ʔumtazaja) /ʔum
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
